subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: After the two source findings are fixed, should maintainers approve this exact-head qa-matrix package removal plus reusable Matrix QA Live workflow secret boundary?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes dependency ownership, lockfile/package graph state, and a secret-bearing reusable release QA workflow, which repository policy treats as human security and ownership approval rather than a purely mechanical review decision.

options.title: Fix findings and approve exact-head boundary
options.body: Repair the Matrix provider default and AGENTS formatting, then have an authorized dependency/workflow owner approve the exact package graph and secret-boundary changes before merge.

options.title: Split the workflow routing
options.body: Land the qa-matrix retirement separately and move reusable release workflow routing into a smaller security-reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause the retirement
options.body: Keep the standalone qa-matrix runtime until maintainers are ready to own the package deletion and release QA workflow churn.

recommendation.title: Fix findings and approve exact-head boundary
recommendation.body: Repair the Matrix provider default and AGENTS formatting, then have an authorized dependency/workflow owner approve the exact package graph and secret-boundary changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow/package-boundary history makes this the best available routing owner for dependency graph and reusable workflow approval.
